如何使用工作流程

该工作流程中的节点组织清晰。您只需配置以下关键参数即可开始批处理：

步骤1：输入训练集文件夹

  • 指定包含要标记的所有图像的文件夹路径。

第2步：选择型号类型

  • 根据您的图像内容（例如，常规、动漫）选择合适的识别模型，以获得更准确的标签。

第 3 步：选择标签类型

  • （核心功能）这决定了生成的标签的样式和格式。根据您的培训需求进行选择：

    • 描述性/简单明了：生成描述性句子。

    • Danbooru / Booru 类标签列表：生成 Danbooru 风格的逗号分隔关键字，这非常适合动漫风格的训练。

    • 中途/稳定扩散提示：生成样式类似于 MJ 或 SD 提示的标签。

    • 许多其他类型，例如艺术评论家和社交媒体帖子可供您探索。

步骤 4：（可选）高级内容控制

  • （微调）此部分提供了一系列切换来精确控制要包含或排除的内容，从而允许进行高级自定义。例如：

    • 包含照明：向标签添加照明描述。

    • 包括相机角度：添加摄像机角度的描述。

    • 排除人员信息：排除与人员信息相关的标签。

    • 包括角色年龄：添加角色的年龄。

    • 您可以自由组合这些选项来生成最适合您需求的标签。

第 5 步：选择标签长度

  • 为生成的标签设置所需的长度。您可以根据您的培训要求选择简短的核心标签或更详细的描述。

第 6 步：最长边

  • 这是图像预处理参数。保留默认值通常就足够了;通常不需要进行任何更改。

第7步：输入风格触发词

  • 输入您想要的任何通用词或触发词包含在每个标签的开头。例如，当为特定角色训练LoRA时，您可以在此处输入角色的名字，例如角色名称.

第 8 步：翻译成英文

  • （主要特点）工作流程有一个内置的翻译节点。通过启用它，您可以自动翻译将生成的标签翻译成英文。这是大多数模型训练的必要步骤，现在可以一次性完成！

步骤9：输入输出文件夹路径

  • 选择一个文件夹来保存所有最终标签文件。工作流程将自动生成一个.txt每个具有相同名称的图像的文件。

重要提示

  1. 辅助工具，并非完全替代品：请记住，AI 自动标记并非 100% 准确。此工作流程旨在提供一个良好的起点。生成的标签必须人工审查和纠正确保您最终训练集的质量！

  2. 推荐流程: 批量生成 -> 手动优化 -> 完成标记。不要跳过“手动优化”步骤！

  3. 检查输出：运行完成后，请检查您指定的输出文件夹以确认.txt已成功为您的图像生成英文标签文件。

我们希望这个增强的工作流程可以帮助您显着提高数据集创建效率！

欢迎下载、试用并分享您的反馈！

How to Use the Workflow

The nodes in this workflow are clearly organized. You just need to configure the following key parameters in order to start the batch processing:

Step 1: Input Training Set Folder

  • Specify the folder path containing all the images you want to tag.

Step 2: Select Model Type

  • Choose the appropriate recognition model based on your image content (e.g., General, Anime) to get more accurate tags.

Step 3: Select Tag Type

  • (Core Feature)This determines the style and format of your generated tags. Choose based on your training needs:

    • Descriptive / Straightforward:Generates descriptive sentences.

    • Danbooru / Booru-like tag list:Generates comma-separated keywords in the Danbooru style, which is excellent for anime-style training.

    • MidJourney / Stable Diffusion Prompt:Generates tags styled like MJ or SD prompts.

    • Many other types likeArt CriticandSocial Media Postare available for you to explore.

Step 4: (Optional) Advanced Content Control

  • (Fine-tuning)This section provides a series of toggles to precisely control what content to include or exclude, allowing for high-level customization. For example:

    • include_lighting: Adds a description of the lighting to the tag.

    • include_camera_angle: Adds a description of the camera angle.

    • exclude_people_info: Excludes tags related to people's information.

    • include_character_age: Adds the character's age.

    • You can freely combine these options to generate tags that best suit your needs.

Step 5: Select Tagging Length

  • Set the desired length for the generated tags. You can choose between short, core tags or more detailed descriptions depending on your training requirements.

Step 6: Longest Edge

  • This is an image preprocessing parameter.Keeping the default value is usually sufficient; no changes are typically needed.

Step 7: Input Style Trigger Words

  • Enter any general words or trigger words you wantincluded at the beginning of every tag. For example, when training a LoRA for a specific character, you can input the character's name here, likecharacter_name.

Step 8: Translate to English

  • (Key Feature)The workflow has a built-in translation node. By enabling it, you canautomatically translatethe generated tags into English. This is a necessary step for most model training and can now be done all at once!

Step 9: Input Output Folder Path

  • Select a folder to save all the final tag files. The workflow will automatically generate a.txtfile for each image with the same name.

Important Notes

  1. Assistant Tool, Not a Full Replacement: Please remember that AI auto-tagging is not 100% accurate. This workflow is intended to provide a good starting point. The generated tagsmust be manually reviewed and correctedto ensure the quality of your final training set!

  2. Recommended Process: Batch Generate -> Manually Refine -> Finalize Tagging. Do not skip the "Manually Refine" step!

  3. Check the Output: After the run is complete, please check your designated output folder to confirm that the.txtEnglish tag files have been successfully generated for your images.

We hope this enhanced workflow helps you significantly improve your dataset creation efficiency!

Feel free to download, try it out, and share your feedback!
